original_description: Connect your FXI Studio account to direct cinematic stills and video clips from a conversation. Ask for a shot and FXI picks a suitable model for the job, shows the result inline and saves every take to your FXI library. Frame chaining turns 2 to 8 scene descriptions into clips where each clip starts on the last frame of the one before, so motion carries across shots. Compose a scene from your saved characters, check your credits and look up past generations at any time. Sign in with your FXI Studio account to get started.
summary_ja: 静止画や動画を生成し、複数ショットをつないだ映像を制作。
limitations: FXI Studioアカウントが必要。2〜8場面をフレームで連結できると説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
